svg.title: GripMower ESP32 Dev Module Wiring Diagram
svg.desc: Schematic showing connections between the ESP32 Dev Module, onboard Mini PC (USB), safety contactor, emergency stop, dock detect, BTS7960 steering driver, AS5600 steering encoder, MM32 hoverboard wheel and blade motor buses, and BMI088 + QMC5883L IMU.
svg.text: mainEmulatorMowgli (MowgliNext Protocol v9) • 3.3 V logic level • Common GND required across all subsystems

g.text: HIGH = energized • Cuts power to all MM32 boards
Switch to GND • Active LOW (clears fault latch)
Closed-loop steering with BEMF current limit
Open-drain TX bus + ext. pull-up resistor on RX1
Open-drain TX bus + ext. pull-up resistor on RX2
Tilt safety cutoff (roll > 45°, pitch > 35°) + ROS IMU

svg.text: Note (ESP32 Arduino core 3.x): RX1 (GPIO14) & RX2 (GPIO32) pull-ups use gpio_pullup_en() + external pull-up resistors — never pinMode(..., INPUT_PULLUP) after Serial.begin().
